summary_1line: Stories of Upamanyu’s devotion, Arjuna gaining Pasupata weapon from Shiva, Atri–Anasuya tested by Ganga, and origins of Madhu–Kaitabha and Durga.

image_candidates.scene_text: A young Upamanyu meditates under a banyan tree as a tiger roars nearby and Shiva and Parvati appear before the fearless child.
Arjuna battles a radiant tribal hunter—Shiva in disguise—in a forest, arrows flying as the god’s wild retinue surrounds them.
Vishnu sits upon the cosmic waters and lifts the demons Madhu and Kaitabha onto his thighs before striking them with his spinning discus.
